title: The bamboo smells like pina colada’s
text: The bamboo smells like pina colada’s. Burns nicely, just doesn’t smell like bamboo

product_metadata.title: Mia's Co Bamboo Scented Candle, Handmade with Natural Soy Wax and Cotton Wicks, 7.5 oz Minimalist Candle for Home, Long Lasting Burning for Stress Relief, Candle Gift for Women
features: ECO-FRIENDLY SOY CANDLES - We use environmentally-friendly materials like soy wax, glass containers, and cotton wicks. We use simple recipes to help create a calm, anxiety-free environment and limiting any negative effects from artificial ingredients or unnatural combinations. This helps to meet many qualities supported by aromatherapy and similar therapeutic properties.

SIMPLE, CLEAN, MINIMALIST - Our candles focus on quality over flash. We limit our design so as to fit your lifestyle inconspicuously and focus on enhancing any area with natural scents, burning for approximately 50 hours.
HANDCRAFTED IN USA - Our scented candles are designed and handcrafted in Los Angeles, CA. Our scents and design are inspired by ingredients and memories encountered around the world.

PERFECT FOR GIFTS - Get one for yourself, for someone special in your life, or for anyone in between. Gift one or a variety of our candles for any holiday: Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day, Christmas, Arbor Day, "Just Because" or any other reason you can think of. We have scents for all people, personality types, and every relationship.

SATISFACTION GUARANTEED - We believe you will love our candles. If for any reason we are wrong, feel free to reach out to us for a fully refund. We want to hear directly from you in hopes of making sure the customer is always satisfied.
